Recent indicators suggest that economic activity has continued to expand at a solid pace. Job gains have remained solid, and the unemployment rate has remained low.

Inflation remains elevated.

In support of its goals, the Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 4-1/2 to 4-3/4 percent.

Voting for the monetary policy action were Chair A, Vice Chair B, Governor C, Governor D, and Governor E.
